from pathlib import Path


def _report_date(path: Path) -> str:
    for line in path.read_text().splitlines():
        if line.startswith('date:'):
            return line[len('date:'):].strip()
    raise ValueError(f'no date: line in {path}')


def latest_report(folder: Path) -> Path:
    reports = [p for p in folder.glob('*.txt') if p.is_file()]
    return max(reports, key=_report_date)
EOF

def test_file_names_carry_no_order(tmp_path):
    (tmp_path / 'z.txt').write_text('date: 2023-12-31\n')

    (tmp_path / 'm.txt').write_text('date: 2024-01-15\n')
    assert latest_report(tmp_path) == tmp_path / 'a.txt'


def test_date_line_need_not_be_first(tmp_path):
    (tmp_path / 'a.txt').write_text('title: x\ndate: 2024-05-01\nbody\n')
    (tmp_path / 'b.txt').write_text('date: 2024-04-01\ntitle: y\n')
    assert latest_report(tmp_path) == tmp_path / 'a.txt'


def test_only_txt_files_directly_in_folder_count(tmp_path):
    (tmp_path / 'a.txt').write_text('date: 2024-01-01\n')

    sub = tmp_path / 'sub'
    sub.mkdir()

EOF
